diagnostics.message: google_bigquery_table.views defines views via an opaque `view.query` string that typically selects from the base tables created by google_bigquery_table.default. Terraform cannot infer this ordering from the SQL, so both resources may be created in parallel and BigQuery can reject the view with a "table not found" error because its referenced table does not yet exist. Add an explicit `depends_on = [google_bigquery_table.default]` to google_bigquery_table.views (there is no idiomatic attribute reference to wire in, since the query is user-supplied).
